description:
Consolidates 3 deferred items from unify-dataframe-sql-default-storage-location
(completed 2026-02-09). The core fix unified DataFrame and SQL storage to
project-local benchmark_runs/. These are follow-up refinements:

1. CLI --global-cache flag to opt into ~/.benchbox/ location
2. Auto-migration of existing ~/.benchbox/dataframe-data/ contents
3. Unify cache subdirectory naming (datagen/ vs dataframe-data/)

anti_patterns.dont: auto-migrate data without explicit user confirmation
anti_patterns.instead: require an explicit migration subcommand with a --confirm flag or dry-run mode
anti_patterns.why: shared global caches may be intentionally cross-project

anti_patterns.instead: use the --global-cache flag as opt-in only
anti_patterns.why: existing users have data at benchmark_runs/ and any default change would silently break their runs

anti_patterns.instead: verify that renaming dataframe-data/ does not invalidate any stored manifest references before committing the change
anti_patterns.why: existing runs have paths baked into result manifests

preserves.behavior: Default project-local storage (benchmark_runs/) continues to work without any flags
Existing DataFrame and SQL data loading paths produce identical results

verifications.description: Existing tests pass - storage paths unchanged by default

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/cli/ -k global_cache -v --tb=short
uv run -- python -c "from benchbox.core.dataframe import data_loader; print(data_loader.get_data_path())"
verifications.description: Default path unchanged when flag absent

work_units.notes:
Wire as a Click option in run.py, pass through the config/context object, thread
into benchmark_mixin.py and down to data_loader.py. Keep the default branch
(no flag) identical to current behavior - only the opt-in path changes.
work_units.summary: Add --global-cache CLI flag to opt into ~/.benchbox/ storage location for shared cross-project caching

work_units.notes: No backward compatibility required. Dropped per owner decision 2026-02-18.
work_units.summary: Add explicit migration command for existing ~/.benchbox/dataframe-data/ contents to project-local

work_units.notes:
Independent of w1 - rename applies to the project-local path regardless of whether
--global-cache exists. Removed needs: [w1] dependency since local naming and the
global cache flag are orthogonal concerns.
work_units.summary: Unify cache subdirectory naming between SQL (datagen/) and DataFrame (dataframe-data/) paths
